info.name: Account Level Webhooks Book Commands Business history API

params.name: book_uuid
params.description: A universally unique identifier (UUID) of the Book used to retrieve its associated business.

items.docs:
This API retrieves the business associated with a given `book_uuid`. It returns the business ID and display name, which can be used with business-level endpoints to access aggregated data across multiple <<glossary:Book>>s. 
A single business can have multiple Books. All books associated with the same business within your organization return the same business ID.

params.name: business_id
params.description: A universally unique identifier (UUID) of the business entity for which you want to retrieve overview information.

items.docs: This API retrieves the full metadata profile for a business entity, including industry classification, loan inquiry history, and addresses derived from bank account holder information.

params.name: business_id
params.description: A universally unique identifier (UUID) of the business entity for which you want to retrieve transction details.

params.name: offset
params.description: Number of transactions to skip for pagination.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of records to return per page, starting from the specified **offset**.

params.name: start_date
params.description: Start date in `YYYY-MM-DD` format from which you want to filter transactions. The system includes only transactions with a `txn_date` on or after the specified date.

params.name: end_date
params.description: End date in `YYYY-MM-DD` format from which you want to filter transactions. The system includes only transactions with a `txn_date` on or before the specified date.

params.name: updated_since
params.description: Timestamp (ISO 8601) for filtering transactions ingested into the system after this time. The system uses `txn_created_ts` to determine the ingestion time. Use this for incremental retrieval to fetch only newly ingested transactions since your last request.

items.docs:
This API retrieves the paginated, deduplicated enriched transactions across all of the requesting org's <<glossary:Book>>s for a given business. Transactions are structurally compatible with the existing book-level enriched transactions API.

params.name: business_id
params.description: A universally unique identifier (UUID) of the business entity for which you want to retrieve summary.

params.name: begin_date
params.description: The start date in `YYYY-MM-DD` format for the financial summary period.

params.name: end_date
params.description: The end date in `YYYY-MM-DD` format for the financial summary period.

params.name: updated_since
params.description: The date from which to retrieve updated business summaries.

items.docs: This API retrieves the chronological financial summary for a business entity, calculated from deduplicated and organization-enriched transactions across all <<glossary:Book>> belonging to the requesting organization.
